action-button-styles:
Action Button Styles

ActionButtonStyle accepts PasswordInputActionButtonStyleBoxed (the default) or PasswordInputActionButtonStylePlain for bare icons.

Usage 

@uiForm.PasswordInput(uiForm.PasswordInputSettings{
	InputName:                "plainActionPassword",
	Label:                    "Password",
	TwoWayStatePath:          "plainActionPassword",
	ShouldShowGenerateButton: true,
	ShouldShowStrengthMeter:  true,
	ActionButtonStyle:        uiForm.PasswordInputActionButtonStylePlain,
})

custom-rules:
Custom Rules

Rules drive the generated password and the criteria checklist: length range, generation length, and the required character classes.

Usage 

@uiForm.PasswordInput(uiForm.PasswordInputSettings{
	InputName:       "customPassword",
	Label:           "Password",
	TwoWayStatePath: "customPassword",

	// OptionalFields
	Rules: uiForm.PasswordInputRules{
		MinLength:                   12,
		MaxLength:                   24,
		GenerationLength:            16,
		ShouldIncludeLowercaseChars: true,
		ShouldIncludeUppercaseChars: true,
		ShouldIncludeNumbers:        true,
		ShouldIncludeSpecialChars:   false,
	},
	ShouldShowGenerateButton: true,
	ShouldShowStrengthMeter:  true,
})

hint-icon-styles:
Hint Icon Styles

HintIconStyle renders the hint trigger as an icon or as a boxed tooltip.

Usage 

@uiForm.PasswordInput(uiForm.PasswordInputSettings{
	InputName:                "boxedHintPassword",
	Label:                    "Password",
	TwoWayStatePath:          "boxedHintPassword",
	ShouldShowGenerateButton: true,
	ShouldShowStrengthMeter:  true,
	HintValue:                "Use at least 12 characters.",
	HintDisplay:              uiForm.InputHintDisplayTooltip,

})

hints:
Hints

PasswordInput forwards the hint settings to InputField, so the hint shows as a tooltip or a description line. The Caps Lock warning takes its own text, text color, text case, and a switch to hide it.

Usage 

@uiForm.PasswordInput(uiForm.PasswordInputSettings{
	InputName:                "hintedPassword",
	Label:                    "Password",
	TwoWayStatePath:          "hintedPassword",
	ShouldShowGenerateButton: true,
	ShouldShowStrengthMeter:  true,
	HintValue:                "Use at least 12 characters.",
	HintDisplay:              uiForm.InputHintDisplayTooltip,
})

sizes:
Sizes

Size reaches InputField through the password component, so the field, the label, and the action buttons scale together: xs, sm, md (the default), lg, or xl.

Usage 

@uiForm.PasswordInput(uiForm.PasswordInputSettings{
	InputName:                "sizedPassword",
	Label:                    "Password",
	TwoWayStatePath:          "sizedPassword",
	ShouldShowGenerateButton: true,
	ShouldShowStrengthMeter:  true,
	Size:                     uiForm.InputFieldSizeLg,
})

strength-meter-colors:
Strength Meter Colors

StrengthMeterColor paints the bar. StrengthCriteriaTextColor paints the checklist, and the two icon colors paint the pass and fail marks.

Usage 

@uiForm.PasswordInput(uiForm.PasswordInputSettings{
	InputName:                "coloredPassword",
	Label:                    "Password",
	TwoWayStatePath:          "coloredPassword",
	ShouldShowGenerateButton: true,
	ShouldShowStrengthMeter:  true,

	// OptionalFields
	StrengthMeterColor:               "primary-500",
	StrengthCriteriaTextColor:        "primary-200",
	StrengthCriteriaFulfilledIconColor:   "emerald-400",
	StrengthCriteriaUnfulfilledIconColor: "amber-400",
})
